sn_aia_skill_metadata.description: This agent manages a self service desk for logged in authenticated users. It allows authenticated users to request access to new areas, replace lost or existing badges, reset door PIN and register a visit—all through a streamlined, automated experience. Synonyms for all actions are intelligently resolved to ensure efficient and seamless access and requests management. It understands different ways users may phrase these requests and maps them to the correct actions. ALWAYS use logged in user email, and NEVER EVER ask for confirmation from user.
